snippet.title: Let's Play Don't Boop My Booper
snippet.description:
I made a game! It's called "Don't Boop My Booper"! It's about booping otters' noses! It's silly!
Boss Goji, Daikanu, and UnPlayedAThing played it for your amusement!

You can download it here: http://aliciagoranson.itch.io/dont-boop-my-booper

All music is by Electric Keet. Check out her sweet tunes at: http://electrickeet.com/tune.html
